about: The optional onboarding step after the profile (Elena, 2026-11-18): how you prepare for new places. English only. Stored with your profile on this device; it may shape what the app shows first, and is never sent to the model or put in a prompt. Q1 is A15 of the thesis codebook (config/codebook_2026-11-12.yaml in thesis-personas, a tool-only question), title and labels word for word; Q2-Q4 are Elena's; Q3 is a 1-5 scale (Elena, 2026-11-21: 1 never, 5 very often). `offers` maps each Q2 option to what the app (or a chatbot) can offer.

title.en: How you prepare for new places

note.en: Optional. Kept on this device with your profile, so SenCity can show first what helps you. Never sent to the model.

title.en: How comfortable do you feel going to a place you don't know?
How do you usually prepare before going somewhere new?

options.en: Look at photos of the place
Check how busy it usually is
Choose a quieter time to go
Know where I can rest or step away
Bring something that helps (headphones, sunglasses, water)

title.en: How often does a place feel like too much for your senses?
When a place feels too much, what helps you?

options.en: Stepping away to a quieter spot

crowds_quieter.en: Crowds and traffic, and quieter alternatives

best_time.en: The best time of day, if known

route_senses.en: The route comparison on the Senses layer

rest_places.en: Nearby seats, shade, toilets and drinking fountains
